description:
The ignored build-provenance stability test copies the whole working tree with a short tar exclusion list. In the main checkout it traversed generated agent worktrees and their target directories, creating a temporary source tree of roughly 23 GiB before the cold build. This is unbounded CI/developer bloat and copies unrelated untracked worktree contents into the test fixture.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The provenance fixture seeds its isolated repository from an explicit repository-input inventory that cannot include `.agents/worktrees`, nested Cargo target directories, `.jit`, Git metadata, or Node dependency trees.
- [hard] REQ-02: Regression coverage creates representative nested generated/worktree content and proves it is absent from the seeded repository while tracked Rust, web build inputs, manifests, locks, and required fixtures remain present.
- [hard] REQ-03: The metadata-only staged/committed change contract still proves no Rust test target relinks, temporary source and cargo-target trees are removed on success and failure, and cargo-ci passes without a generated-input allowlist.
- [hard] REQ-04: The implementation records concise source-file and byte counts before the cold build so future snapshot growth is observable and actionable.
title: Bound provenance test source snapshots
